title.zh: 【Akash 团队计划离开 Cosmos，并选定 Solana 作为迁移目标】
title.en: 【Akash 团队计划离开 Cosmos，并选定 Solana 作为迁移目标】

current_state.zh: Akash Network's core team has selected Solana as the target for migrating off its Cosmos sovereign chain, planning to rebuild its compute marketplace as native Solana programs and issue AKT as an SPL token pending governance approval, audits, and a two-year 1:1 migration portal.
